title: The owner decides the six open questions from the 2026-10-28 UX audit
acceptance: Run rule: whether empty plan blocks, songs outside a block and over-time blocks block a run, only a music start, or nothing. The answer is recorded here and unblocks RF-133.
Readiness vocabulary: either rename each readiness dimension by what it checks, or collapse to "Can run" and "Can play music". Recorded here; unblocks RF-134.
Tempo: provision GetSongBPM (owner sets the secret after a terms and quota check), stop flagging missing BPM on the Classes list, or both in order.
HIIT on the Classes home template cards: add the third card, or note on RF-37 why there are two.
Account Preferences: cut (RF-144 names the three Account sections in D21) or keep (a new record defines the preferences).
Spotify while the developer allowlist is unresolved: hide its library and playback for accounts not on the allowlist, or keep it visible and name the real cause.
Each answer is recorded in this record and in run-decisions.md; any new implementation gets its own Backlog record.
nextAction: Owner answers the six decisions, one at a time, starting with the run rule. Briefs with options and what each costs are in docs/audits/ux-audit-2026-10-28/run-decisions.md "Owner decisions". This record authorizes no implementation.
